ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; dominant low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white/tan) pixels restricted to scarring and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation base across the fluke surface. Concentrated tan/brownish pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes. Scattered, non-contiguous white circular points across the mid-section and left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow V-shaped notch dividing the lobes with a high internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by varying peak amplitudes and jagged valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch extending to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, white circular and annular pixel clusters scattered across the fluke surface, most notably on the mid-left and central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, short white linear streaks visible on the central-left lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Bulbous tan-colored clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; irregular jagged truncation/physical damage at the terminal end of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: White filamentous debris/material trailing from the right distal tip; white water spray masking the fluke base.
